# Trump tells Mamdani he won't get a dime from the federal gov't for "FAKE communist promises"
President Donald Trump **[tore NYC mayoral front-runner Zohran Mamdani apart](https://substack.com/redirect/35e3ffb8-da77-499f-a0e5-57d1f59aff86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Truth Social, calling him a "Communist" and threatening to withhold federal funding from New York City if Mamdani wins, stating "He won't be getting any of it, so what's the point of voting for him?"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/35e3ffb8-da77-499f-a0e5-57d1f59aff86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Adams suspends campaign amid pressure** : The attacks came one day after Mayor Eric Adams suspended his campaign following pressure from Trump and others who wanted him to quit the race to improve former Gov. Andrew Cuomo's chances of defeating Mamdani in November's general election.
* **Crowded race continues** : Mamdani, who identifies as a democratic socialist (not a communist), defeated Cuomo in the Democratic primary, while Cuomo is now running as an independent alongside Adams, and Republican nominee Curtis Sliwa has refused to drop out despite pressure from Trump and others.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/35e3ffb8-da77-499f-a0e5-57d1f59aff86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

# Trump announces $625 million investment to modernize American coal plants to meet AI demands
The Trump administration **[announced a major funding package of $625 million to modernize coal plants](https://substack.com/redirect/086a9262-79d3-4fe3-b80e-9bbb584cd06d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , improve wastewater systems, enable dual-fuel operations, and support coal projects in rural communities to keep the industry competitive.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/086a9262-79d3-4fe3-b80e-9bbb584cd06d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **AI race demands** : Energy Secretary Christopher Wright argued the investment is essential for winning the "global race for dominance in artificial intelligence," with coal currently providing 15-16% of U.S. electricity and supporting the country's reindustrialization efforts.
* **Reversing previous administration policies** : Wright stated that coal has been "under assault" during the Biden and Obama administrations, calling it the "backbone" of steel production, critical for cement manufacturing, and necessary to support the AI boom and American industrial strength.
* **Export and domestic use expansion** : The investment aims to increase U.S. coal exports while maintaining domestic use for American industry, with Wright emphasizing that coal has "a long future" and urging Americans to "stop wishing it would go away" given its importance to the country's economy.

# Capitalism narrowly preferred over socialism by New Yorkers: Poll
A Fox News poll of New York City voters **[found 48% hold a favorable view of capitalism compared to 41% for socialism,](https://substack.com/redirect/628ee3ec-10c7-4246-a7f2-be233627474d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while 40% view capitalism unfavorably versus 44% who view socialism negatively.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/628ee3ec-10c7-4246-a7f2-be233627474d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Sharp partisan and gender divides** : Democratic voters had a net negative view of capitalism (41% favorable vs. 49% unfavorable) but favored socialism (49% vs. 35%), while male New Yorkers strongly preferred capitalism (59% favorable) over socialism (40%), and independent voters favored capitalism 45% to 27%.
* **Socialist politicians more popular than socialism itself** : Despite the modest preference for capitalism as an economic system, democratic socialist candidate Zohran Mamdani holds a 50% favorable rating among New Yorkers, with supporters citing his focus on affordability and change, while Sen. Bernie Sanders enjoyed a 61% favorable rating.
* **Opposition centered on ideology** : Among the 38% who view Mamdani unfavorably, 28% specifically cited his communist or socialist views as their primary concern, while 11% referenced his positions on Israel and Gaza or accusations of antisemitism, and another 11% opposed his policy ideas generally.

# EA is going private in record-setting $55 billion deal
Electronic Arts **[agreed to be acquired by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund,](https://substack.com/redirect/886bc104-0f8e-4462-b06d-fdc29dee0a8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners in an all-cash deal worth $55 billion ($210 per share), set to become the largest leveraged buyout in Wall Street history.
* **Saudi PIF as majority investor** : The Public Investment Fund is rolling over its existing 9.9% stake and will be the majority investor in the new structure, with the group making a $36 billion equity investment combined with $20 billion in debt financing from JPMorgan.
* **Jared Kushner involvement** : Affinity Partners CEO Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law, praised EA's "bold vision for the future" and expressed excitement about the company's iconic gaming franchises including Battlefield, The Sims, and Madden NFL.
* **Deal timeline and structure** : The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of fiscal 2027, with a 45-day window allowing for competing proposals, while EA CEO Andrew Wilson confirmed he will continue leading the company under the new ownership structure.

# Biotech giants crushed by rapidly declining demand for COVID-19 vaccines
Moderna and BioNTech shares **[have plunged 95% and 78% respectively](https://substack.com/redirect/39b351c0-ad32-4e35-b984-b283b78f8638?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from their August 2021 peaks, reducing eight billionaire founders' combined wealth from $116 billion to $28.8 billion, driven by declining vaccination rates and reduced government purchasing, Forbes reports.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/39b351c0-ad32-4e35-b984-b283b78f8638?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **RFK Jr. 's impact on industry**: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s appointment as HHS Secretary has created chaos for vaccine makers, including firing the CDC director, replacing the vaccine advisory committee with less-experienced, anti-Covid-vaccine members, and restricting the latest Covid vaccines to adults over 65 only.
* **Continued Covid vaccine dependence** : Despite promises to develop mRNA vaccines for other diseases, both companies remain heavily reliant on Covid-19 vaccine sales--95% of Moderna's $3.2 billion revenue and 88% of BioNTech's $3 billion revenue in 2024, with projected declines of 32% and 20% respectively for 2025.
* **Different financial positions** : BioNTech appears better positioned with $19 billion in cash, partnerships with Pfizer and Bristol Myers Squibb that share risk, and a pivot to cancer treatments, while Moderna spent $5.3 billion on share buybacks, has only $7.5 billion remaining, and faces FDA/CDC roadblocks on its RSV vaccine and flu/Covid combo shot.

name: The Turning Point USA Family
subject: God is so good
body:
Even now... it still doesn’t feel real that we lost Charlie.

| | | [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2ztajld05p1spts181s5m3vm1n1ghqa6d6nvb51r8_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shge8ob2c3h2bs)
---
Friend,Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction -- it shaped all of us.And his vision -- **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** -- is why Turning Point USA exists today.Friend, that's why we have an uplifting update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zhl4qkrhki75gei3luhc7190lsjrh40r3e182ka8_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shge8ob2c3h2bs)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️To give you perspective, Friend...Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters.It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zh409dm4vv1h5ae5aqege47i8fr94qlcbivu7o90_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shge8ob2c3h2bs)
---
He always believed this day would come.He used to talk about it all the time -- how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America.And now... _It 's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible.And more beautiful than we can even describe.**Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _" What can I do?"_As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request.And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started -- including: **✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won 't be a small task. _ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here 's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit -- ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?

We’ll cut to the chase: Our first quarterly fundraising deadline hits TOMORROW, and we need your help now!
**_[Would you consider donating $5, $15, $25, or even $50 to Kendall’s campaign today so we can hit our quarterly fundraising goal before midnight tomorrow, September 30?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zl60o1v3sksi6153gbhmdo7p0kbga66je27vld60_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shge4pj0cjh2bs)_**

| | Here’s the thing: we’re up against a well-funded, powerful Democratic machine; a machine that’s selling a lie. They want you to think the American dream is dead. They want you to think success is only possible with government handouts and a bloated bureaucracy.
_That’s simply not true, and Kendall proves it_. He grew up in the slums of Harlem and a trailer park in Oklahoma. With a lot of hard work and determination, he became a successful businessman and married father of five.
He’s the embodiment of the American dream, but these days, too many Minnesotans have lost faith in the promise of America. Kendall’s running for governor to fix that. [Will you help us spread his message by donating to his campaign today?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zmcnpkjp22fe78mqcrp876emtmmg4cbu7s1tjc1g_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shge4pj0cjh2bs)

| | **_With your help, we’ll be the movement that saved our state, restored it, and passed it on to the next generation._**
To do that, we need your help before our deadline hits tomorrow. [Can we count on you?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z2j20u269asbrijvsgo1qdcruuif3oujq6esedgo_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shge4pj0cjh2bs)
Thanks!
-Team Qualls

---

My name is Kendall Qualls. I wasn’t born into privilege or power. I was raised in Harlem, New York, in the 1960s; a child of divorce and one of several siblings living in public housing. Before I reached middle school, I moved to a trailer park in Oklahoma to live with my father. Neither of my parents finished high school.
I didn’t take shortcuts. I worked full-time to put myself through college. I used student loans and paid them back in full. I served as an officer in the United States Army. I earned an MBA from the University of Michigan. Then, I spent 30 years leading teams and driving innovation in the healthcare industry — rising to become Global Vice President of an $850 million business unit.
Now, I’m running for Governor of Minnesota to make sure that the principles that lifted me - hard work, faith, family, personal responsibility, and the free enterprise system - are preserved, defended, and passed on to the next generation.
We don’t need more government. We need more opportunities.
That’s what I’m fighting for, and I need your help. [Can I count on your support today?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z8nqog3fv95v2ef9peng3k6ds420a8rqlq2agu40_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shge4pj0cjh2bs)
With gratitude,Kendall Qualls

| | Team,

Fellow Conservative,

ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
Thank you to everyone who responded to my message at the end of last week to support the Texas Justice Fund. What an incredible response! I am grateful to all of you who contributed, and to all of you who are in this fight—and have been—for all the right reasons.
These are challenging days for us all. And there is so much going on. The redistricting efforts and the trial that starts this week in Texas. The increasing political violence and dysfunction. The looming government shutdown if Congress doesn’t act by tomorrow.
And all of this is coming together at the end of the third quarter of the year and the reporting deadline for federal campaigns. If your inbox looks like mine, you are probably getting a lot of requests from candidates for support at the end of the quarter. And we all know by now that at the end of every quarter, campaigns are legally required to file a finance report with the Federal Election Committee, which shows—supporters, potential opponents, and all who are watching the strength of our campaign.
As always, I am grateful for your support, and will be so if you can make a contribution to help us end this quarter strong—making sure that we have the resources to run a strong primary campaign in March and general election campaign in November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe250929?refcode=lpfe250929]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe250929?refcode=lpfe250929]
As of now, this report is scheduled to be the last report before the filing deadline for the 2026 election, so people who might want to get in the race will be watching to see the strength of this campaign.
Your contributions allow us to run our own strong campaign and to continue to raise awareness, organize across the state, and fight back against this dangerous and undemocratic power grab from now to next November. Thank you.

But we've also seen defenders of voting rights standing up for our fundamental right to vote. We've just got to make sure our grassroots power can match their dark money millions and suppressive media empire.

Our time in the barrel has come, Team .
President Donald Trump said just hours ago that he will lead a "movement" to get rid of mail-in ballots and voting machines , falsely claiming that they lead to voter fraud.
Word for lying word: " I am going to lead a movement to get rid of MAIL-IN BALLOTS, and also, while we're at it, Highly 'Inaccurate,' Very Expensive, and Seriously Controversial VOTING MACHINES, which cost Ten Times more than accurate and sophisticated Watermark Paper, which is faster, and leaves NO DOUBT, at the end of the evening, as to who WON, and who LOST, the Election. "
How is Trump going to do this? He's signing an executive order ahead of next year's critical midterms. Is this just another attempt to distract from a failing economy, rising prices, and his role in the Epstein scandal? Probably, yes. Are we going to fight him tooth and nail? You betcha.
We're going to work in the states to defend our access to cast ballots, as they run elections. We're going to petition members of Congress to stop harmful bills that might attempt to back up this executive order. And we're going to do everything we can to support the efforts to stop this in court.
We'll be blunt: We still need your help to protect our fundamental right to vote. Chip in with $25 or whatever you can today to defend vote by mail across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092925_2&amount=25]

Trump has long lied about mail-in voting. He's claimed mail-in voting contributed to his 2020 election loss, though no widespread fraud has been found. In fact, the one case of mail-in ballot fraud in Pennsylvania after the 2020 election was a man who was prosecuted for returning his dead mother's ballot for Trump .
We all know just how safe and secure mail-in voting is. It's use dates back to the Civil War. The use of mail-in voting has become very common across the country and study after study has shown that fraud in mail-ballot voting is rare. There are also several safeguards in place nationwide to protect against fraud, including signature requirements and barcodes to track envelopes sent by officials. States have spent tens of millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing.
Being blunt: There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access. There is no good-faith reason to end the use of mail-in voting, or do the other things in this forthcoming executive order or his previous one attacking vote-by-mail. Just like the wave of redistricting efforts in Texas, Florida, and beyond -- this is a partisan voter suppression exercise meant to codify MAGA's power in perpetuity and end our democracy.
Opponents of voting rights will go to any length necessary to stop people from voting and stay in power. Help us fight back with $25 or whatever you can to protect mail-in voting and stop their suppressive policies >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092925_2&amount=25]

body:
Just 1 day left to reach our goal

| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znlj50k6e0h7v792u3l66gdnboi8c5tl8d8aoud8_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shgecoj6c3h2bs)

| | Patriot,
We’ll cut to the chase: Our first quarterly fundraising deadline hits TOMORROW, and we need your help now!
**_[Would you consider donating $5, $15, $25, or even $50 to Kendall’s campaign today so we can hit our quarterly fundraising goal before midnight tomorrow, September 30?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z153buk1kq2k0bhdkd22fjqadrov5qee24u8rhr8_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shgecoj6c3h2bs)_**

| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq5jctppifm8fmkrtbf7j70qtknv9sn03qrt9djo_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shgecoj6c3h2bs)
---
| | Here’s the thing: we’re up against a well-funded, powerful Democratic machine; a machine that’s selling a lie. They want you to think the American dream is dead. They want you to think success is only possible with government handouts and a bloated bureaucracy.
_That’s simply not true, and Kendall proves it_. He grew up in the slums of Harlem and a trailer park in Oklahoma. With a lot of hard work and determination, he became a successful businessman and married father of five.
He’s the embodiment of the American dream, but these days, too many Minnesotans have lost faith in the promise of America. Kendall’s running for governor to fix that. [Will you help us spread his message by donating to his campaign today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zec6k7pab072c09i03slvd5r0amu586h7d7ms1jg_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shgecoj6c3h2bs)
---
[BECOME A DONOR TODAY](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znjre4uhbc2aidjn2d4u4p6glu33bir5r41qp0uo_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shgecoj6c3h2bs)
| | **_With your help, we’ll be the movement that saved our state, restored it, and passed it on to the next generation._**
To do that, we need your help before our deadline hits tomorrow. [Can we count on you?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd8h7fspcjf2brb6u8i1bap0ccd4tnncnhnpmik0_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shgecoj6c3h2bs)
Thanks!
-Team Qualls
---
| | |
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv55f7i7g5b9val3kvr53u5thbi3rr5n2vo6u5ug_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shgecoj6c3h2bs)
---

My name is Kendall Qualls. I wasn’t born into privilege or power. I was raised in Harlem, New York, in the 1960s; a child of divorce and one of several siblings living in public housing. Before I reached middle school, I moved to a trailer park in Oklahoma to live with my father. Neither of my parents finished high school.
I didn’t take shortcuts. I worked full-time to put myself through college. I used student loans and paid them back in full. I served as an officer in the United States Army. I earned an MBA from the University of Michigan. Then, I spent 30 years leading teams and driving innovation in the healthcare industry — rising to become Global Vice President of an $850 million business unit.
Now, I’m running for Governor of Minnesota to make sure that the principles that lifted me - hard work, faith, family, personal responsibility, and the free enterprise system - are preserved, defended, and passed on to the next generation.
We don’t need more government. We need more opportunities.
That’s what I’m fighting for, and I need your help. [Can I count on your support today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvgr356eqo57rbidrfk79ro9t3mqkektdad1a410_rp22sh2s8i6epb4shgecoj6c3h2bs)
With gratitude,Kendall Qualls

name: The Flyover
subject: A Flyover Update — and a Big Push for Q3
body:
The Flyover isn't just growing -- it's thriving. But with Q3 ending tomorrow, we need your help to finish strong and keep building a reader-owned future for news.

| | |
---
| |
#
---
Dear Flyover Reader, Since we've invited _Flyover_ readers to become owners in August, the response has been truly humbling. And because of these early investments we've already put to work, we've achieved some incredible new milestones I'd like to share with you. **It 's because of our early investors that:**
* _The Flyover_ 's audience has grown from around**2.5 million** readers in August to nearly**3 million today** _(CNN primetime audience is half a million.)_
* _**The Texas Flyover**_ is on track to surpass **500,000 readers** by year's end, **up 21%** since August.
* _**Flyover Florida**_ has grown by **32%** since new investments began (look out Texas!) -- proof that your support and investments make the difference.
* **The Flyover Podcast** is breaking records for views and listens.
* And we're now preparing to launch **_The Flyover_ App** and **_Flyover_ Text Alerts**, opening even more ways for Americans to access fact-first news.

Every milestone I just listed has happened _since our readers began investing in The Flyover._ That's why we are more excited than ever to finish this campaign strong.
* * *
**Why I 'm Reaching Out Today** Our goal was to be at **50% of our funding by the end of Q3.** Today, we're at **42%**. With the quarter ending tomorrow, I'm asking you directly: [**will you help us close the gap?**](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskc1uqzAQhZ_G7BKZMT_xwouri9ilaaVKXVqDPQZXxiAwifr2FW2aVZfdzjfz6YzO21mf0Qcf-yccSSU3aUvWG0xkdaTbGiglWjS68DFdadlmi4kwWux8P2_roIFDeeDyAFL_b90WQvO4LzOrHBGQyEjldSnzShbilA3KyoqKTnSuAjBoHBSAVQ2GjOXSuTLzavdyCTI_5VzUR-wc2rLmJ6hrQhCs4GR9mpbj--RjGuge8GimMQtqSGlemfjHoGXQ-nilNf2yuWPRbmnU67QthphoHvEZVDsYyfptZKK53CLZw5msxzsyOM7o-8hE0347f8AUE8XERPMinrd1uI8TLbvotb00WoKEMluUnW8-BL9WNSt4P6IPXx-kP6_iquAzAAD__z_TqI8) Investments start at just **$750 (only $2 per share),** and virtually every dollar goes toward growth -- building new audiences, launching new states, driving more revenue, and fueling future profits.

This seat could determine control of Congress.
And that's not an exaggeration. With or without redistricting, this seat will remain a must-win for Democrats if we're going to break the Republican majority in the House and gain the ability to fight back against Trump and his fascist agenda.

But the truth is, this is exactly who he's always been — a man who believes the rules don't apply to him. In just the past couple months alone, Donald deployed National Guard troops to patrol American streets and seized control of D.C.'s police force. He's pushing to ban mail-in voting and voting machines altogether to silence millions of voices. And his MAGA allies are rewriting congressional maps to steal elections and lock in Republican control for years to come. This is what authoritarianism looks like. It's happening right in front of our eyes, which is why I needed to write to you. I admire Jane Fonda more than I can say because she doesn’t just call out injustice, she acts. This has always been true. Her Climate PAC is one of the few organizations taking on two of the most powerful forces that define my uncle’s agenda: authoritarian politics and the fossil fuel industry that bankrolls him and thousands of candidates across the country. **But no one person can do this all alone. Friend,
Asking for help has never been my strong suit, but today, I’m asking that you spare just a minute of your time to understand my situation.
The Democrats and their Deep State thugs are cashing in on a years-long scheme to **JAIL** me for the rest of my life.
**A Democrat Attorney General is making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
_As it stands, I’m simply out of options._

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: Our upcoming FEC report
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Republican Super PACs could see our fundraising and decide whether or not to spend against Alexandria.
#
At midnight tomorrow, we’ll close our books on our quarterly fundraising and then submit a report to the FEC.
After that, our numbers will become public and everyone—reporters, our opponents, even Donald Trump himself—will be able to see our numbers.
**Republican Super PACs could see our fundraising and decide whether or not to spend against Alexandria** based on how strong they perceive our campaign to be. In 2020, this was the second most expensive House race in the country—our opponent raised and spent more than $10 million. So we need to be prepared.
We will never try to scare you into donating. We believe in respecting the folks who are on our email list.
[ But we will politely ask: can you donate $5 ahead of our deadline at midnight tomorrow to help us reach our $250,000 end-of-quarter goal?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250929.SSNEZ3&refcode=em20250929-9848-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9848%2E2526796%2EstTz3t)

Team AOC

body:
5 Wins to celebrate this International Safe Abortion Day | | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193536/572767483/2141984067?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237) | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193538/572767485/2141984067?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237)
---|---
Peter,

Yesterday was [**International Safe Abortion Day**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193539/572767486/685614430?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237)—a chance to shine a light on the crucial role that accessible, safe abortion care plays in the lives of people around the globe.

**Abortion is one of the world's most common medical procedures.** It's considered an essential service by the World Health Organization—and when carried out properly, it's both safe and simple. But when legal restrictions put safe, quality abortion services out of reach, people are forced to seek care elsewhere.

Nearly half of the world's 73 million annual abortions are unsafe—resulting in tens of thousands of deaths per year and accounting for up to 13% of maternal deaths. The numbers speak for themselves: **Safe abortion is a matter of life and death.** The good news? [**More and more countries are expanding protections and access**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193541/572767488/685614430?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237). [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193542/572767491/685614430?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237)
_Our flags fly high on Geneva's Mont-Blanc Bridge for International Safe Abortion Day with the messages "Reproductive rights are human rights" and "Les droits reproductifs sont des droits humains."_
1. **Nigeria:** This June, the Federal High Court recognized the right to safe abortion for victims of sexual violence—a breakthrough ruling in a country where three in five abortions are unsafe. [**The decision sets a major legal precedent that could be used to further expand abortion access across Nigeria.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193543/572767492/-1204780725?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237)

2. **Nepal:** Once home to one of the world’s highest maternal mortality rates, [**Nepal has transformed abortion into a guaranteed right.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193544/572767493/-39596906?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237) After years of advocacy and legal battles, abortion is now free in all government health facilities, helping drive a 71% drop in maternal deaths. [**Watch the documentary to learn more about one of the great reproductive rights success stories of the past 20 years.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193545/572767494/-1885747224?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237)

3. **England & Wales:** [**In June, the UK House of Commons voted overwhelmingly to repeal a 19th-century law that criminalized women who sought abortion outside of legal pathways.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193546/572767495/834120233?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237) Across the region, lawmakers are continuing to align their countries' abortion laws with international human rights standards and public health guidelines—helping to ensure quality abortion care for all. Read more: [**Europe Abortion Laws: Policies, Progress and Challenges**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193547/572767497/-1837883438?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237)

4. **Latin America:** Latin America has long been home to some of the world's most restrictive abortion laws, but grassroots activism and our legal work are helping shift that reality. Two landmark rulings from the United Nation Human Rights Committee in response to complaints filed by the Center on behalf of four young rape survivors who were denied abortion care found that denying abortion violated the girls’ human rights, ordered reparations, and directed governments to reform their laws to ensure safe, legal abortion. The Committee’s rulings apply across 173 states, strengthening the global legal framework for abortion. [**Discover more about the "Son niñas, no madres" ("They are girls, not mothers") cases.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193551/572767499/-247556953?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237)

5. **United States:** Despite the overturn of _Roe v. Wade_ , the majority of Americans support the right to abortion—and voters have affirmed that at the ballot box, with [**Michigan passing a constitutional amendment in 2022**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193555/572767509/-2072044586?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237) and [**Arizona following in 2024**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193557/572767518/473514809?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237). Yet harmful state restrictions remained, including Arizona's 15-week criminal ban and Michigan's laws mandating biased counseling, waiting periods, and limits on qualified providers. The Center filed lawsuits in both states, and this year courts struck those measures down—[**permanently blocking Arizona's ban**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116193559/572767527/-1736423914?sourceid=1150902&utm_campaign=26emcma-0908aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGY3ZWEwZi02NzlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rxJGX_uj5eH9WkrhKePNmOeNXyjhUSIOn6nwWUQQlV4=&emci=d44445f7-f29a-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=60f7ea0f-679d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237) and removing three of the challenged restrictions in Michigan.

Abortion is health care, and people continue to need it regardless of what courts or lawmakers decide. Putting safe abortions out of reach doesn't keep people from them—it keeps people from surviving.

clean_body: 5 Wins to celebrate this International Safe Abortion Day | | | ---|--- Peter, Yesterday was —a chance to shine a light on the crucial role that accessible, safe abortion care plays in the lives of people around the globe. Abortion is one of the world's most common medical procedures. It's considered an essential service by the World Health Organization—and when carried out properly, it's both safe and simple. But when legal restrictions put safe, quality abortion services out of reach, people are forced to seek care elsewhere. Nearly half of the world's 73 million annual abortions are unsafe—resulting in tens of thousands of deaths per year and accounting for up to 13% of maternal deaths. The numbers speak for themselves: Safe abortion is a matter of life and death. The good news? . Our flags fly high on Geneva's Mont-Blanc Bridge for International Safe Abortion Day with the messages "Reproductive rights are human rights" and "Les droits reproductifs sont des droits humains." 1. Nigeria: This June, the Federal High Court recognized the right to safe abortion for victims of sexual violence—a breakthrough ruling in a country where three in five abortions are unsafe. 2. England & Wales: Across the region, lawmakers are continuing to align their countries' abortion laws with international human rights standards and public health guidelines—helping to ensure quality abortion care for all. The Committee’s rulings apply across 173 states, strengthening the global legal framework for abortion. 5. United States: Despite the overturn of Roe v. Wade , the majority of Americans support the right to abortion—and voters have affirmed that at the ballot box, with and . Yet harmful state restrictions remained, including Arizona's 15-week criminal ban and Michigan's laws mandating biased counseling, waiting periods, and limits on qualified providers. The Center filed lawsuits in both states, and this year courts struck those measures down— and removing three of the challenged restrictions in Michigan. Abortion is health care, and people continue to need it regardless of what courts or lawmakers decide. Let us break it down: We don’t take a dime of corporate PAC money, so when John takes the floor in the Senate, he isn’t thinking about how his votes might come off to corporate donors — he’s only thinking about families, farmers, and small businesses back home, **because the people of Colorado are John's only boss,_not corporations looking to buy his support._** Look, John was just a laid-off geologist turned small business owner before he entered politics. And when he first ran for office, he didn’t do it to gain power or pad his wallet. **John got into politics because he saw how the concerns of everyday folks in Colorado simply weren’t being heard — and he decided to change that. Fellow Conservative,

The partisan divide gripping our nation has turned Washington into a warzone of its own—fierce, unrelenting, and filled with entrenched elites more interested in power than progress.

_**As a Navy SEAL, I've faced harsh environments and impossible odds, from battlefields abroad to the political arena at home. Those experiences taught me how to stay calm under pressure, broker compromise, and accomplish the mission—no matter the stakes.**_

I'm Sen. Tim Sheehy, and I'm in the U.S. Senate to serve you, not the special interests or partisan extremists. We lose.

have our FEC filing deadline tomorrow, and your contribution will get us

My top priority is to make a real difference for the working people in our
country who are facing massive threats to their Social Security, to their
wages and fair pay, and to their health care. And, of course, to stand up
to Trump and for our democracy.

From securing funding for more affordable housing to lowering grocery
costs, I’m hearing from countless families worried about making ends meet
in a dire economic situation. But now, as Trump is threatening a
government shutdown, it’s more important than ever to hold the GOP
accountable.

Unfortunately, Donald Trump and Senate Republicans are making this work
much more difficult. Every day, there’s a new update on how they’re
cutting jobs, slashing federal spending or vital programs, and disrupting
the crucial work to help hard-working families get by.

And while they should be focused on bringing down inflation as they
promised, instead, they spend a lot of their time personally attacking me
on Fox News.

Here’s what you need to know: Trump will try to distract us with his lies
and smears. But that can’t stop us from holding him and his cronies
accountable and making sure voters know the real consequences of their
destructive agenda.

name: Jon Ossoff
subject: Let me lay this out
body:
This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-ftp-tjo?refcode=em250929&refcode2=745_2563979_a_Lh7M&akid=745%2E2563979%2Ea_Lh7M)
_Let me lay this out, clear as day:_
I am the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won in 2024.
This Senate race in Georgia will be the most competitive and most expensive in the nation.
If you’re outraged by what’s happening to our country — and you’re ready to fight –– **[please split $5 between my reelection campaign and KDH For The People before our end-of-quarter deadline tomorrow.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-ftp-tjo?refcode=em250929&refcode2=745_2563979_a_Lh7M&akid=745%2E2563979%2Ea_Lh7M)**
**[SPLIT A DONATION](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-ftp-tjo?refcode=em250929&refcode2=745_2563979_a_Lh7M&akid=745%2E2563979%2Ea_Lh7M)**
Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation.
Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning.
I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible.
I also ran — years before the _Dobbs_ decision — because it was already clear the GOP was coming for reproductive rights. I saw Georgia as the front line in that fight. With a six-week ban now in place here, and Republicans pushing for a national abortion ban, it still is.
**Now this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history:**
* He’s freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf.
* Purged independent watchdogs across government.
* Stacked key agencies with loyalists — and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
* Defied and threatened federal judges.
* Undermined the press.
* Handed sweeping, unaccountable power to the billionaire who spent $300 million to elect him.

Trump’s goal isn’t just revenge. He wants to use the government to crush the opposition. And now, Americans are living in fear of their own government.
This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it is the test of our lifetimes.
**In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history — and we won. That victory won the Senate majority.**
Now we must win again. And we will win again.
Just like last time, I can’t do it alone.
So I’m asking:
**[Please split a contribution between my reelection campaign and KDH For The People before tomorrow's FEC deadline, of $5 or any amount that works for you.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-ftp-tjo?refcode=em250929&refcode2=745_2563979_a_Lh7M&akid=745%2E2563979%2Ea_Lh7M)**
The average online donation to our campaign is around $30. Many give less. Some give more.
All that matters is that lots and lots of people are contributing what they can to power our grassroots campaign. Please, contribute before our deadline.
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-ftp-tjo?refcode=em250929&refcode2=745_2563979_a_Lh7M&akid=745%2E2563979%2Ea_Lh7M)**
Thanks for being part of this team.
As always,
Jon Ossoff

KDH For The People Inc. is a nonprofit social welfare organization that is exempt from federal income tax under section 501(c)(4) of the Internal Revenue Code. Please note that contributions to this organization are not generally tax-deductible. The mission of KDH For The People Inc. is to strengthen communities across America through the promotion of economic opportunity, justice, and protection of fundamental freedoms.
This email was sent to **dpwillis67@gmail.com**. Thank you so much for being a supporter. But we don't want to bother you. If you’d like to unsubscribe, you can **[click here.](https://harris.actionkit.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1&akid=745%2E2563979%2Ea_Lh7M)**

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: I’ve got to ask you:
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
In Arizona, we’ve got a slate of strong people running statewide. We’ve got excellent candidates for Congress. I’m doing whatever I can to help them out.
#

Peter, it’s Ruben.
I’m asking you to make a donation before our official FEC fundraising deadline hits at midnight tomorrow.
I’m not blind — I know what’s going on around the country, I know times are tough, and I know it’s never a great time to make a donation.
Here’s the truth, though: We won an incredibly tough campaign for Senate last year, in a state Trump took by 5.5%.
I’m one of just a few Democrats who pulled it off. To do it, we had to win over voters of every kind — Democrats, Republicans, independents, everybody. It wasn’t easy, but we figured it out. And because of that, I’m getting asked to do a lot of travel to help other candidates win their races.
In Arizona, we’ve got a slate of strong people running statewide. We’ve got excellent candidates for Congress. I’m doing whatever I can to help them out.
Nationwide, I’ve been to Pennsylvania, Iowa, New Hampshire, and led a tele-townhall with Alaska Democrats — all places with a bunch of elections we really need to win.
I’m doing all of that because we need to take back the House and Senate next year. If we don’t we’ve got four straight years of Trump, so this is really, really important.
Winning back Congress is my top priority. If it’s yours, too, I’m asking you:

# Heading back out there!
---
|
---
| | I was glad to visit friends and allies at the Lafayette & Greenwood Carpenters Union open houses! These hard-working men and women show the importance of American industry and the people that make it! I am proud of their support for my run and I look forward to supporting them in Congress!
---
|
---
|
---
| | I made it back to my neck of the woods in Plainfield for the Hendricks County Lincoln Day Dinner. I had friends old and new gathered to hear amazing words from some great speakers and show the state how Hendricks County Republicans put on an event.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
|
---
| | Finally, to end a packed week, I head up north to visit my friends in Warren County and have some amazing BBQ at their annual fall picnic event! I love it when small counties can some together and share true community values we as Republicans cherish deeply! Thank you Chairman Clay Andrews for an amazing event!
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
---

Our momentum is just getting started and I can’t wait to continue to share with you who is already on board. If you ever want to get involved or endorse, please reach out!

name: Derek Tran
subject: brief note
body:
Hi there, I appreciate you opening this message.

I know it’s Monday, and you’ve heard a lot from campaigns like mine about tomorrow’s FEC deadline – so I’ll keep it brief.

I just got off the phone with my finance director, Sonali, and we’re running short of our end-of-quarter goal. National Republicans, our challengers, and supporters alike will be able to comb over our fundraising report come October.

As you know, I flipped CA-45 last year in one of the nation’s most closely-watched races. Only 653 votes separated me and the MAGA incumbent.

So as we move closer to my first re-election race, I’m not taking anything for granted. _Especially as Californians vote on redrawing congressional maps in November, and if passed, thousands of new voters will be folded into my district._

With the margin of error extremely close in this district, we’re preparing now for the voter outreach we’ll need to win – not only to keep this seat blue, but give Democrats a fighting chance to flip the House and hold this administration accountable.

There’s a lot of work to be done, and it starts with meeting tomorrow’s fundraising goal. If you’re with me, can I count on your support with $3 or any amount that’s meaningful to you?

Here’s a good link to give: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dt-q3-2025](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116196373/572777015/1527952032?refcode=em-9.29.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDY3MTY2ZmItNmU5ZC1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=eKOBBnzYU9y4ijwCn_5vJG92nZ1iS1Eg30RSSViv218=)**

Thank you,
Derek

**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.

He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time -- how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It 's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _" What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started -- including: ** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won 't be a small task. _ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here 's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit -- ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?

Peter,

Laura Loomer just attacked me with the same tired, Islamophobic garbage
I’ve heard my whole life.

It’s ugly, it’s extreme, but it won’t stop me, because this campaign isn’t
about me.

This campaign is about the work we’re doing to build a government that
actually supports working people.

And when you rally to fix a broken system, you scare people like Laura
Loomer, who’ve been exploiting and distracting us for far too long.

We see the same behavior from AIPAC and corporate PACs, too. They’re
meddling in our primary to boost a milquetoast candidate because they’re
desperate to gain more power over our democracy.

It’s all part of the same playbook: Keep us divided, keep us afraid, keep
the bullies in charge.

But I’ve never let bullies win.

Not when I was a kid with a funny name on the playground.

Not when corporate polluters tried to poison our kids.

And not now, when wannabe oligarchs and MAGA extremists are trying to shut
us out.

The truth is, these attacks are only going to get louder,
Peter.

AIPAC will spend millions against us. Corporate PACs will flood the
airwaves. Bullies from the MAGA machine will throw everything they can at
us.

But together, we are stronger than their money, stronger than their fear,
stronger than their hate.

This campaign is about proving that when people stand
shoulder-to-shoulder, no amount of smears or dark money can stop us from
building a government that works for everyone.

I hope you’ll stand with me.

In solidarity,

Abdul

name: Ken Martin
subject: A longer message about the DNC’s work:
body:
---
Derek, It’s getting close to the end of the month, which means our next end-of-quarter deadline is approaching fast. In a minute, I’m going to ask for [**your support to help us reach our goal**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2025?refcode=em_20250929_4695_fr&amount=3&refcode2=4695_22930333_aiZQG7&akid=4695%2E22930333%2EaiZQG7), but first, I hope you’ll give me a chance to explain why goals like these matter — especially right now. This is a longer message, but this is important, and I hope you’ll read it all the way through. Here’s the deal: As Democrats, we're going to fight for everyone, no matter where you're from, no matter where you live, no matter who you love, no matter who you are. I firmly believe everyone in this country deserves an opportunity to get ahead. To build a better life for their family. To actually climb the economic ladder, achieve the American dream, and pass something better off to their families. And that's what we’re focused on as a Democratic Party. But the _only_ way we’ll bring our vision for this country to life is if we have the resources to elect Democrats at all levels of government. We have to win elections, win states, and build majorities. That’s where our quarterly fundraising goals come in. Hitting our end-of-quarter goal will help us ensure the DNC has the funds we need to support Democrats across the country. And when we meet our goal, we can continue to support our candidates, organizers, and volunteers — and continue to expand our efforts to reach the voters who need to hear Democrats’ message the most. **I’ve always said that Democrats need to show up everywhere. We need to show voters exactly what we stand for – in blue states, red states, and purple states.** Americans need to see Democrats fighting every single day as Trump and his allies try to dismantle democracy — gutting voting rights, redrawing congressional maps, threatening to end vote-by-mail, and even threatening to jail political opponents. The best way to gain ground is by building ourselves up brick by brick. That’s why we announced an initial seven-figure investment in Virginia and New Jersey ahead of their elections this fall. It’s why we’ve launched new ads in red districts to hold cowardly Republicans accountable and tell voters to call their representatives to tell them to do their job and put the needs of working-class Americans first. _This is the kind of work that grassroots donations fund._ If you’re on the fence about getting involved right now, I’ll leave you with this: **We need you. We need you now more than ever. I need each of you to roll up your sleeves.** If you don't belong to the party yet in your community, join your local county committee or your state party. Volunteer, get out there, and start talking to voters right now. There is too much on the line for any of us to shrink away from this fight. [**There are millions of us who won’t stand idly by and let Trump and his allies do whatever they want. What kind of future can we build when we all stand together? If protecting our democracy is worth $3 to you, that’s the contribution I’m asking you to make to the DNC before our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2025?refcode=em_20250929_4695_fr&amount=3&refcode2=4695_22930333_aiZQG7&akid=4695%2E22930333%2EaiZQG7) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_ | | | **[CONTRIBUTE $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2025?express_lane=true&amount=3&refcode=em_20250929_4695_fr&refcode2=4695_22930333_aiZQG7&akid=4695%2E22930333%2EaiZQG7)**

Ken

BREAKING FROM MSNBC:
Trump wants to end voting by mail.
Oregon won't give it up easily.
Hi, it's Oregon Secretary of State, Tobias Read.
President Trump is at it again — and this time, he’s coming straight for Oregon’s democracy.
He’s threatening an executive order to end vote-by-mail before the midterms.
Let me be crystal clear: that is unconstitutional, reckless, and an attack on every Oregonian who has made their voice heard through our secure, proven system for more than 25 years.
Oregon’s vote-by-mail elections are a national model. Fraud is virtually nonexistent. Participation is among the highest in the country. Democrats, Republicans, and independents alike rely on it. President Trump knows all of this — and he still wants to rip it away. Why? Because he’s trying to avoid accountability in next year’s elections.
Well, I have news for him: Oregon will not back down.
We are prepared to challenge President Trump at every step — in the courts, in the public square, and anywhere else he tries to undermine our democracy. But to mount that fight, I need your help.
We've set a goal of raising $10,000 by the end of September to defend Oregon from Trump's assault. Can you help us defend Oregon's elections? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250929em-eom1]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250827em-msnbc-FR]
This is bigger than one state. If Trump gets away with dismantling Oregon’s vote-by-mail system, it sets a dangerous precedent for the entire country. That’s why our defense has to be fierce, and it must start now.
Together, we’ll protect Oregon’s democracy — and show Donald Trump that no executive order can silence the people.
Thank you,
Tobias Read
P.S. You can read my op-ed here [https://www.msnbc.com/opinion/msnbc-opinion/trump-vote-mail-executive-order-oregon-rcna226337] , and please share it with your friends and networks >>

body:
Fair Fight needs your help to protect our freedom to vote |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116198411/572783467/1793776944?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250929_T1_SYAEOQNOR_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTIxNGZlYS03MjlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VMEpVAyCMTPsuWVcyP2t0PLnmzdyDduGmdPBRKdXlKQ=&emci=a7b521f1-4b9d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=91214fea-729d-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=1037277)

| | My home state of Georgia has a long, shameful history of voter suppression. And we see that history continue today, with Republicans mounting a recent purge of nearly half a million voter registrations. But in parallel, Georgia has a storied history of resistance against systemic barriers to the ballot box. And that is the legacy we must look to, and be inspired by, as free and fair elections are at risk around the country. Today, the Trump Regime and its MAGA allies are barreling our country toward an autocracy. body:

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t3dbch&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol3c3wiok9flw8vrpf9v4addk33nqp2agc0cdzom2yz6rjivnq8ed50k0o5tw7f43vrcrq2o83hal4k7f0bxblfvyd2hqogv82delks9kee1judlmglt4xpnvi1o4ttzkgct9uprnlt5&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t3dbch&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t3dbch&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t3dbch&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t3dbch&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

null,

I talk to Michiganders every day, and one thing keeps coming up over and over: People are scared.
They’re scared because the federal government’s approach to public health is guided by dangerous pseudoscience – causing endless chaos and confusion.
And it's because Donald Trump put a fringe conspiracy theorist in charge of public health.
Well, I’ve had enough.
**Last week, I announced I’m drafting articles of impeachment against Robert F. Kennedy Jr., Trump’s secretary of Health and Human Services.**
There might not be anyone more dangerous in Trump’s Cabinet right now.
RFK Jr. has fired the CDC director, leading to department-wide uncertainty. He’s purged essential government scientists and gutted research into cancer, HIV, addiction, and mRNA technology – research that saves lives and powers Michigan’s innovation economy. And he’s lied to members of the U.S. Senate under oath.
I called for his resignation earlier this month. **But when I saw him standing next to Trump, telling pregnant women not to take Tylenol – claiming, with zero proof, that it could cause autism – I hit my limit.**
Telling women to “tough it out” during pregnancy? Give me a break. That’s advice a middle school gym teacher gives when you get hit too hard with a dodgeball – not medical advice for a woman who is growing an entire human in her body.
It’s dangerous. It’s dishonest. And it’s disqualifying.
We need thoughtful leaders who put science over BS. Facts over conspiracy theories. People over politics. RFK Jr. has proven – over and over again – that he is not one of them.
And if he doesn’t like it? _Tough it out._
Thanks for standing on the side of science. Let’s keep fighting.
Haley

I’m even more proud of the swift action he’s taken in his first months in the House. Days after he was sworn in, Southern California faced the worst wildfires in its history – and George was immediately back in our area advocating for aid.

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
2025 may be an "off year" election as far as Congress goes, but that doesn't mean we don't have important elections this year or we can take a break with our voter registration work, folks.
Voter registration is open in New Jersey until October 14th -- and early voting starts on October 25th. Control of their state legislature hangs in the balance, while it's also an open race for governor as the current governor is term-limited.
Voters can register in Virginia until October 24th , with early voting starting on September 19th. Virginia's legislature is also up for grabs, plus the opportunity to replace the current vote-suppressing governor (who is term-limited) with someone who will protect voting in the commonwealth again.
Our mission is simple: The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .

clean_body: I’m the conservative Republican running in Nevada’s battleground 3rd Congressional District to unseat Democrat incumbent Susie Lee. | Let’s run this back, friend. I’m Marty O’Donnell, and I’m the conservative Republican running in Nevada’s battleground 3rd Congressional District to unseat Democrat incumbent Susie Lee. Susie voted twice to impeach President Donald Trump, yet her district was one of only thirteen represented by Democrats that voted to re-elect President Trump in 2024. This makes Susie Lee and this seat one of the top targets for conservatives to flip in 2026. I first ran against Susie in 2024, and am once again running in 2026 to finish the fight and get the job done. Like President Trump, I’m not a politician. In fact, I’m a musician and composer, known worldwide for my award-winning composition work on the highly acclaimed Halo video game series. I’m just a regular guy who is tired of politicians like Susie Lee running our country into the ground. I want the working middle class to be able to thrive again and chase the American Dream, and I want there to still be an America to leave for my grandchildren. But I’m not going to play political games in order to win this fight, and I’m not going to take donations from Corporate PACs and special interests. I don’t want to be beholden to them. I only answer to you. I can only compete with Susie Lee’s war chest and her special interest allies if we have a deep and robust grassroots operation. Without your support at critical junctures like this, we can’t stand a chance. Thank you again, and let’s finish this fight! Marty O’Donnell Conservative for NV-03 | ABOUT MARTY Marty O’Donnell isn’t a politician and he’s not taking any corporate PAC money. Marty will give us a voice – not special interests or Wall Street. He’s an award-winning composer who wrote the iconic soundtracks for the video games Halo and Destiny. Marty will cut through the noise in DC. Marty O’Donnell will be a champion for Nevada families. ## Commonsense Corner:
---
Another shutdown is looming—and it’s not because of some bipartisan failure. Let’s call this one what it is: the Schumer Shutdown.
Democrats have abandoned hardworking Americans. Their priorities are crystal clear: wide-open borders, handouts for those who broke our laws, and an obsession with woke experiments that have no place in a serious nation.
This shutdown fight exposes the truth:
* **They want taxpayer-funded healthcare for people who entered illegally—while millions of American citizens are left struggling to afford basic coverage.**
* **They want radical surgeries forced into the lives of kids too young to understand the consequences—a reckless, destructive agenda that crosses every moral line.**

This is what the Democratic Party stands for in 2025. It isn’t compassion. It isn’t justice. It’s dangerous. And it’s tearing at the foundations of our country.
We need to draw the line somewhere. Americans are fed up, and most of them would rather have a shutdown than watch Republicans cave to this nonsense. It’s time to demand better for our families and the country we hold dear.

We just received BIG news--your free speech is SAFE against two draconian censorship laws out of California!

The laws censor political speech and even punish people for posting a simple, funny meme and then require online platforms to censor that speech--if the government deems the content "materially deceptive." So, The Babylon Bee, along with a California lawyer and video-sharing platform Rumble, challenged the laws for violating their free speech rights--**and today, a court agreed with them.**

This is an incredible win for free speech. And it's because friends like YOU stood by The Babylon Bee and helped them fight this egregious government overreach.

But it's not the end of the story. The Babylon Bee's battle to protect humor and free speech isn't over.

Their rights--and yours--are still under threat in Hawaii, thanks to a law that goes even further than California's.

Hawaii's law threatens fines, damages, and even _jail time_ if a person posts a political meme that government officials don't like. It's all part of a growing trend of censorship. Across the country and the globe, government officials and private actors alike are cracking down on speech in cases like this.

With your help, The Babylon Bee is fighting Hawaii's law--no one should face jail time because a politician doesn't get your joke.

This victory in California is promising, but your help is needed to keep up the fight for free speech. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this | | | Hi Fellow American, We just received BIG news--your free speech is SAFE against two draconian censorship laws out of California! The laws censor political speech and even punish people for posting a simple, funny meme and then require online platforms to censor that speech--if the government deems the content "materially deceptive." So, The Babylon Bee, along with a California lawyer and video-sharing platform Rumble, challenged the laws for violating their free speech rights--and today, a court agreed with them. This is an incredible win for free speech. And it's because friends like YOU stood by The Babylon Bee and helped them fight this egregious government overreach. But it's not the end of the story. The Babylon Bee's battle to protect humor and free speech isn't over. Their rights--and yours--are still under threat in Hawaii, thanks to a law that goes even further than California's. Hawaii's law threatens fines, damages, and even jail time if a person posts a political meme that government officials don't like. It's all part of a growing trend of censorship. Across the country and the globe, government officials and private actors alike are cracking down on speech in cases like this. With your help, The Babylon Bee is fighting Hawaii's law--no one should face jail time because a politician doesn't get your joke. This victory in California is promising, but your help is needed to keep up the fight for free speech. For Freedom, Alliance Defending Freedom Alliance Defending Freedom 15100 N. 90th Street, Scottsdale, Arizona 85260

Hi Peter, There’s a retention election happening for Pennsylvania’s Supreme Court next month. If you don’t know what that is, that’s okay — most people don’t, even many Pennsylvanians. In fact, Republicans are _banking_ on people not paying close attention to this off-cycle election, where voters essentially have to decide to rehire their current justices for another term by voting “yes” or “no” in November. Another reason Republicans might be so dead set on winning this Supreme Court retention election in Pennsylvania?
Back in 2018, the Pennsylvania Supreme Court struck down the GOP’s congressional gerrymander. The courts in the past have always been a backstop to prevent the partisan, anti-democracy extremism we see behind egregiously gerrymandered maps. The modern Republican Party is doing its best to change that by changing the face of the judiciary at all levels of government.
**That’s why it’s so essential that we fight to protect the pro-democracy majority on the Pennsylvania Supreme Court. We must preserve our backstop in the courts so that Republicans don’t even think for a second about trying to force through an extreme gerrymander in this key battleground.**

name: Peggy Light
subject: I'm Matching Your Gift
body:
https://savetheredwoods.org [https://savetheredwoods.org]
Dear Peter,
My love of nature and the redwood forests runs deep. I grew up believing you could be part of the business world and still hold a deep, abiding love for natural places. That belief has guided me my whole life. Every time I stand in a river with my fishing rod in hand, and a coastal redwood canopy above, I can take a breath and think about how lucky I am to have spent some of the best days of my life in the presence of these ancient giants.
My journey with the League began in 1982 as a donor, but my roots go back even further as a third-generation supporter. Today, I’m honored to serve as a League Councilor.
What I love most about the League is its brilliance in striking a balance between protecting vast swaths of land and also making them accessible to the public. To me, that balance of conservation, protection, and access is exactly what keeps the redwoods alive for all of us to enjoy.
https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/evergreen-match [https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/evergreen-match]
Photo Credit: Thomas Kline / Alamy
As a lover of fishing, hiking, and soaking in the beauty of the natural world, nature reminds me why this work matters. Once you feel the majesty of a redwood forest, you want to make sure it’s there forever. [https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/evergreen-match]

name: Wes Moore
subject: More comfortable in cargo shorts
body:
Thanks to your support, I can be my authentic self.
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=688%2E1086043%2EzoU2uX)
Peter, I’ve got to be honest.
This is the first office I was ever elected to, and frankly, it takes some getting used to! I’m more comfortable in cargo shorts than a suit. And while I can’t meet everyone who **[donates to this campaign,](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250929-2?refcode=em-20250929-2&refcode2=688_1086043_zoU2uX&akid=688%2E1086043%2EzoU2uX)** I wanted to share a bit more about myself.
As you may know, I first got my start by serving in the Army.
I was sent to military school when I was twelve. At the time, it was the absolute _last_ place I wanted to be. But getting my start in the military taught me humility, teamwork, and the importance of serving others. And even as I started my life of public service, **I had no idea I would grow up to be Maryland’s first Black governor.**
Now, a lot has changed, but the important things have remained the same: service, gratitude, and humility continue to be the foundation of everything I do.
These principles are what keep me grounded as governor, and they’re the foundation of everything we’re doing for Marylanders.
**[If you agree with this type of leadership, can I count on you to chip in $5 or any amount before our end-of-quarter deadline? Your support will be crucial.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250929-2?refcode=em-20250929-2&refcode2=688_1086043_zoU2uX&akid=688%2E1086043%2EzoU2uX)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250929-2?amount=5&refcode=em-20250929-2&refcode2=688_1086043_zoU2uX&akid=688%2E1086043%2EzoU2uX)**
**Now, I’m fighting for every Marylander to succeed and thrive.** It may feel like an uphill battle right now, but I know we can do this together.
To succeed I need support from folks like you who believe in our mission. That’s why I’m asking:
**[Will you make a donation of any amount before our end-of-quarter deadline to help us out?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250929-2?refcode=em-20250929-2&refcode2=688_1086043_zoU2uX&akid=688%2E1086043%2EzoU2uX)**
Elevate,
Wes
