# Trump warns Hamas, release the hostages or Israel will "finish the job"
President Donald Trump **[released a comprehensive plan to end the Gaza war](https://substack.com/redirect/c639bc90-97d4-4998-a847-e69d765f9e78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's White House visit, proposing immediate ceasefire, hostage releases within 72 hours, and Israel withdrawing to agreed-upon lines with suspended military operations.
* **Amnesty for surrendering Hamas fighters** : The plan offers amnesty to Hamas members who commit to peaceful coexistence and surrender their weapons, with safe passage provided to receiving countries for those wishing to leave Gaza, while establishing Gaza as a "deradicalized terror-free zone."
* **Hostage exchange provisions** : Israel would release remaining hostages (alive or deceased) within 72 hours of accepting the agreement, followed by releasing 250 life-sentence prisoners plus 1,700 Gazans detained after October 7, 2023, once all hostages are returned.
* **Ultimatum backed by both leaders** : Trump warned Hamas that rejecting the deal would result in Israel having his "full backing to finish the job of destroying the threat of Hamas," with Netanyahu adding that Israel "will finish the job by itself" if Hamas refuses or undermines the agreement, while Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas signaled support and readiness to take over Gaza security and governance.

# No agreement reached, Gov't shutdown looms in next 48 hours
Congressional leaders met with President Donald Trump for roughly an hour on Monday but left with **[no agreement](https://substack.com/redirect/b9adf8e4-a6b4-4b2a-9534-24233b4b295a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to avert a government shutdown before the October 1st midnight deadline, with both sides refusing to budge from their positions.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/864cf93e-682f-4f79-974d-b6378669a4b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Republican position and unity** : Vice President JD Vance, flanked by Speaker Mike Johnson, Senate Majority Leader John Thune, and OMB Director Russell Vought, accused Democrats of "hostage-taking" and said Republicans support a "clean" short-term funding extension until November 21st without Democratic policy additions.
* **Democratic healthcare demands** : House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries and Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer insisted on including permanent extensions of expiring Obamacare tax credits and reversing healthcare cuts from the GOP's reconciliation bill, stating "we are not going to support a partisan Republican spending bill that continues to gut the health care of everyday America."
* **Mass firing threat remains** : The White House continues to leverage threats of federal employee mass firings beyond standard furloughs if the government shuts down, though Senate Democrats have not yielded to the pressure, with the Senate expected to vote again on the funding bill Tuesday.

Hostage exchange provisions : Israel would release remaining hostages (alive or deceased) within 72 hours of accepting the agreement, followed by releasing 250 life-sentence prisoners plus 1,700 Gazans detained after October 7, 2023, once all hostages are returned. Ultimatum backed by both leaders : Trump warned Hamas that rejecting the deal would result in Israel having his "full backing to finish the job of destroying the threat of Hamas," with Netanyahu adding that Israel "will finish the job by itself" if Hamas refuses or undermines the agreement, while Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas signaled support and readiness to take over Gaza security and governance. | | | | ---|---|--- | 9:47 PM | No agreement reached, Gov't shutdown looms in next 48 hours Congressional leaders met with President Donald Trump for roughly an hour on Monday but left with to avert a government shutdown before the October 1st midnight deadline, with both sides refusing to budge from their positions. Republican position and unity : Vice President JD Vance, flanked by Speaker Mike Johnson, Senate Majority Leader John Thune, and OMB Director Russell Vought, accused Democrats of "hostage-taking" and said Republicans support a "clean" short-term funding extension until November 21st without Democratic policy additions. Democratic healthcare demands : House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries and Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer insisted on including permanent extensions of expiring Obamacare tax credits and reversing healthcare cuts from the GOP's reconciliation bill, stating "we are not going to support a partisan Republican spending bill that continues to gut the health care of everyday America." Mass firing threat remains : The White House continues to leverage threats of federal employee mass firings beyond standard furloughs if the government shuts down, though Senate Democrats have not yielded to the pressure, with the Senate expected to vote again on the funding bill Tuesday. subject: A letter from me

body:
To my supporters:
Growing up in rural Virginia, I was often reminded that I didn’t fit in — too country, too poor, too gay. But when I came to this state, I found something different: opportunity and acceptance.
Here, I was able to buy a home, marry my spouse and the love of my life Jennifer, and build a career in public service. California gave me everything.
I entered this race because I still believe in the promise of California — and I’ve spent my life trying to fulfill that promise for more Californians.
From my time on the San Diego City Council and as Acting Mayor, to serving as Speaker of the Assembly, and later leading the State Senate, we’ve gotten a lot done.
My intention was to build on that progress, to bring real solutions from day one, and to do good work for the people.
That’s why it’s with such a heavy heart that I’m stepping aside today as a candidate for governor.
Despite the strong support we’ve received and all we’ve achieved, there is simply no viable path forward to victory.
Though my campaign is ending, I will keep fighting for California’s future.
With Donald Trump and his allies threatening everything we’ve worked for — gutting health care, cratering our economy, and stripping away fundamental rights and freedoms — we’ve got to make sure California has a Democratic governor leading the fight, and that means uniting as Democrats.
To everyone who supported this campaign over the past 20 months — whether you made a call, chipped in, showed up, or simply shared a kind word — thank you. And to those who opened up about your struggles, your hopes, and your vision for California, I carry your stories with me every day. This campaign was never about the spotlight. It was about you.
You were the heart of this campaign. And while this chapter is closing, what we built together is not. The work continues — in every community, every conversation, and every act of courage and hope.
It has been the greatest honor of my life to serve California. I believe, with all my heart, that California is worth fighting for.
-Toni G. Atkins

Encinitas CA, 92024

body:
To my supporters:

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/d39be7562fe9/a-personal-letter-from-toni?e=199d0c411d)
---
|
---
| | | | | |
To my supporters:
Growing up in rural Virginia, I was often reminded that I didn’t fit in — too country, too poor,__ too gay. But when I came to this state, I found something different: opportunity and acceptance.
Here, I was able to buy a home, marry my spouse and the love of my life Jennifer, and build a career in public service. California gave me everything.
I entered this race because I still believe in the promise of California — and I’ve spent my life trying to fulfill that promise for more Californians.
From my time on the San Diego City Council and as Acting Mayor, to serving as Speaker of the Assembly, and later leading the State Senate, we’ve gotten a lot done.
My intention was to build on that progress, to bring real solutions from day one, and to do good work for the people.
That’s why it’s with such a heavy heart that I’m stepping aside today as a candidate for governor. Despite the strong support we’ve received and all we’ve achieved, there is simply no viable path forward to victory. Though my campaign is ending, I will keep fighting for California’s future.
With Donald Trump and his allies threatening everything we’ve worked for — gutting health care, cratering our economy, and stripping away fundamental rights and freedoms — we’ve got to make sure California has a Democratic governor leading the fight, and that means uniting as Democrats.
To everyone who supported this campaign over the past 20 months — whether you made a call, chipped in, showed up, or simply shared a kind word — thank you. And to those who opened up about your struggles, your hopes, and your vision for California, I carry your stories with me every day. This campaign was never about the spotlight. It was about you.
You were the heart of this campaign. And while this chapter is closing, what we built together is not. The work continues — in every community, every conversation, and every act of courage and hope.
It has been the greatest honor of my life to serve California. I believe, with all my heart, that California is worth fighting for.
-Toni G. Atkins

Dearest Ophelia,
I write to you from the gangrenous environs of "war-ravaged" Portland. I thought I had seen it all during my early days of service--Bosnia, Rwanda, Eric Trump's gum line.
But this, my dear, is truly odious.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ca78eb4e-585b-4da6-aaca-22f23691bbb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The filth is stomach-churning
Yes, this may be no Bowling Green Massacre. Or [an escalator that has ceased ferrying one's margarine exterior up 18 whole steps](https://substack.com/redirect/d5bac46d-0fcb-4042-a081-33f20a4c47b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ca78eb4e-585b-4da6-aaca-22f23691bbb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I am a trifle discomfited by the many challenges we face on this Monday, 29th of September, anno Domini nosti Jesus Christi, 2025.
There are the shortages of gluten-free curry at Elephant's Delicatessen the likes of which no-tarot reading could've predicted. So I must exist solely on a diet of artisanal nut cheeses, plant-based collagen and vegan honey.
[Oh what have we done to deserve such a fate, Ophelia!](https://substack.com/redirect/ca78eb4e-585b-4da6-aaca-22f23691bbb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Jack has disappeared again, no doubt training with the ghost regimen known as Antifa.
I know one day we shall see him again-and actually see them...at all--when he is done sharing his dastardly messages across town with his large array of environmentally-friendly, easy-removal spray paint.
But if you think me a ninny, my darling, fret not. For even as we have tried to make ourselves scarce during this onslaught, we have encountered creatures I suspect have been sent by Beelzebub himself:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ca78eb4e-585b-4da6-aaca-22f23691bbb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ca78eb4e-585b-4da6-aaca-22f23691bbb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ca78eb4e-585b-4da6-aaca-22f23691bbb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
They will try convince us, Dearest Ophelia, that all shall be well. That our righteous God shall prevail.
But I feel naked, as my only night vision goggles--usually for bird-watching--have been pilfered by a particularly spirited English Springer Spaniel.
And it hasn't rained for three days, making me think, the time of His Judgment must truly be forthcoming. Look at what transpires just outside our humble abode, Ophelia:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ca78eb4e-585b-4da6-aaca-22f23691bbb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[How could any men committing such despicable acts go unpunished](https://substack.com/redirect/c2e82511-983f-40ce-9782-0c3c095727d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
It is as if, somehow, the worst fecal-sprinkled matter God and nature could think to birth all gathered together in one titanic assemblage. How could any ville survive this?
To gather supplies, I foraged through the forest one Godforsaken evening, only to encounter the most virulent and vestigial forms into which Our Maker has ever breathed life:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ca78eb4e-585b-4da6-aaca-22f23691bbb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ca78eb4e-585b-4da6-aaca-22f23691bbb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Please share, my dear, who be these wanton beasts, who seem capable of scheming so endlessly together? As if they spent many years as best friends, searching out those in danger from a most wretched life of freedom, happiness and safety! Younger souls, ophelia, cloistered by those mean-of-spirit, besieged by a Godless foe they could not parry. As if they set out with a sickness, a greed of the flesh for the many innocents he hast placed among us. May these youngins escape, find safety from their savagery. As, in peace they simply wish to exist. So we pray James Bowman David Hamel JD Vance lifts them up beyond the Heavens, and that we do the same in ravaged Portland before end times are nigh.
Or, from what the fair Frances has told me, we just [put $50,000 into a bond](https://substack.com/redirect/0fba0bbb-e2a3-40d4-9742-5bedee79909e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), or pack it [into a paper bag](https://substack.com/redirect/49f87664-5f5c-4c18-a8e6-65b37fbc9a43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), hand it over, and ask not a question....
One last note, before I must take my leave of you, fair Ophelia.
Sure, [some call our President a prize hog at the country fair](https://substack.com/redirect/fa41c0e6-2c4e-4cf6-8f89-241b6fad27f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), one who rolls around in the very primordial ooze from which he hast been made.
An irascible, implacable, mushroom-d*k-impotent, invasive airborne virus only good at attracting horse flies and untethered syphilis.
A cogntively-cured retch on the road to constructing a mephistophelean, malodorous, mortgaged, malfunctioning society for which his brain-drained, black-hearted, purple-handed, burrito-sack body is all too ready to deliver our already ill society.
But, have faith, my dear. I don't believe any of this, of course.
The man who said, and I quote "Person, Woman, Man, Camera, TV" is clearly the right man to save Portland from its natural beauty and urban decor. The gorgeous views from Mt. Tabor Park.
The South Park blocks that feature statues, small gardens and fountains. The higher-IQ populace that cares about education and not twirling their belly-button lint just for the pure entertainment of it, my dear.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ca78eb4e-585b-4da6-aaca-22f23691bbb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Shithole Country
This great, orange man shall finally help us become that for which humans have prayed since the days of antiquity: a land with Florida's vaccinations, Texas' weather preparation and South Dakota's gross national product.
My Ophelia, stay strong, and as the sun sets slowly in The West, I bid you a fond farewell.
Jebediah

To gather supplies, I foraged through the forest one Godforsaken evening, only to encounter the most virulent and vestigial forms into which Our Maker has ever breathed life: | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- Please share, my dear, who be these wanton beasts, who seem capable of scheming so endlessly together? As if they spent many years as best friends, searching out those in danger from a most wretched life of freedom, happiness and safety! Younger souls, ophelia, cloistered by those mean-of-spirit, besieged by a Godless foe they could not parry. As if they set out with a sickness, a greed of the flesh for the many innocents he hast placed among us. May these youngins escape, find safety from their savagery. As, in peace they simply wish to exist. So we pray James Bowman David Hamel JD Vance lifts them up beyond the Heavens, and that we do the same in ravaged Portland before end times are nigh. Or, from what the fair Frances has told me, we just , or pack it , hand it over, and ask not a question.... One last note, before I must take my leave of you, fair Ophelia. Sure, , one who rolls around in the very primordial ooze from which he hast been made. An irascible, implacable, mushroom-dk-impotent, invasive airborne virus only good at attracting horse flies and untethered syphilis. A cogntively-cured retch on the road to constructing a mephistophelean, malodorous, mortgaged, malfunctioning society for which his brain-drained, black-hearted, purple-handed, burrito-sack body is all too ready to deliver our already ill society. But, have faith, my dear. I don't believe any of this, of course. The man who said, and I quote "Person, Woman, Man, Camera, TV" is clearly the right man to save Portland from its natural beauty and urban decor. The gorgeous views from Mt. Tabor Park. The South Park blocks that feature statues, small gardens and fountains. The higher-IQ populace that cares about education and not twirling their belly-button lint just for the pure entertainment of it, my dear. | | ---|---|--- Shithole Country This great, orange man shall finally help us become that for which humans have prayed since the days of antiquity: a land with Florida's vaccinations, Texas' weather preparation and South Dakota's gross national product. My Ophelia, stay strong, and as the sun sets slowly in The West, I bid you a fond farewell. Jebediah | | ---|---|--- ** You're currently a free subscriber to . name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Sam Bregman BUSTED - Democrat Primary EXPLODES Over Plagiarism Scandal
body:
Plus, Trial Lawyer Admits He's Blocking Your Medical Care. New for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=fabfdcdc37&e=567664f14c)
| | | | | |
The Democratic governor primary [just exploded into open warfare](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=25a3c72e94&e=567664f14c), and it's absolutely delicious political theater. Sam Bregman tried to look serious with a 189-page policy plan - then got busted for plagiarizing it from government reports!
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=8bce7d41ee&e=567664f14c)
| |
🔥 **DEMOCRAT PRIMARY MELTDOWN IN NEW MEXICO**
Sam Bregman thought he was being clever by releasing a massive 189-page policy document to challenge Deb Haaland to debates. Instead, he handed her ammunition when reporters discovered he'd plagiarized sections verbatim from legislative reports and federal studies.
Haaland's campaign response was swift: "There's too much at stake to put rushed, plagiarized policy together."
This is playing out exactly as we predicted - Bregman trying to engage Haaland one-on-one while she avoids direct confrontation. In their first real exchange, Bregman's undisciplined approach backfired spectacularly when he gave his opponent easy attack lines.
The New Mexican is already taking sides against Bregman, which tells you how the media will line up. Any Republicans thinking Bregman will run as a centrist are deluding themselves - he's getting pushed left and will continue facing attacks from that direction.
**Neither candidate offers much hope for conservatives, but watching them tear each other apart over basic competence issues is certainly entertaining.**
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=e4167076ae&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
📊 **KELLER VULNERABLE DESPITE POLL LEAD**
New Albuquerque Journal poll shows Tim Keller leading the mayor's race with 29% to Darren White's 16%, but the real story is his weakness:
✅ Keller is 10 points underwater on favorability
✅ 60% of voters say it's "time for someone else"✅ High undecided numbers despite 100% name recognition✅ $733K in public financing couldn't fix his image problem
This race likely goes to a runoff, where it becomes Tim Keller vs. Donald Trump rather than Keller vs. White. We'll see if Albuquerque voters care more about their city or sending meaningless messages to Trump.
💰 **TRIAL LAWYER'S STUNNING ADMISSION**
Brian Colon wrote the most self-serving op-ed we've ever seen, defending trial lawyers while New Mexicans suffer without medical care. His best line? "We're not going against local doctors" - yeah, because you already chased them all away!
Colon calls trial lawyers "equalizers" while blocking medical compacts that would bring telehealth care to patients. The only doctors left are big Manhattan hospital corporations because independent physicians can't afford the malpractice environment these lawyers created.

The race for Governor of Virginia is neck-and-neck — and early voting is already underway. [**That’s why I’m asking you to split a donation between Abigail Spanberger and our campaign — to help her become the next governor of Virginia and keep up our fight to get Democrats elected up and down the ballot.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3163?amount=28&t=8&akid=2665%2E4032634%2EttTNM9) Here’s why the stakes in this race are high:

* Abigail’s opponent is in lockstep with Trump’s agenda — even waving off the White House laying off thousands of Virginia workers by saying, “don’t fret.”
* The governor’s race in Virginia is the only one where a seat could flip from red to blue in 2025 — and we can send a clear message that we outright reject what Republicans are doing right now.

This is the most important election of Trump’s second term so far. National Republicans are throwing millions of dollars into this race, and Trump himself has started launching attacks. [**With voters headed out to the polls right now, will you split $28 or anything you can between our campaign and Abigail Spanberger’s to help her compete and win? Several ultra-MAGA opponents have entered the race. And GOP-aligned Super PACs are already spending millions attacking me. This is the fight ahead. And I need you by my side. Before you turn in: = | = When I first ran for Senate five years ago, it was because I believed the election of someone so deeply unfit for the presidency posed a danger to the country. Many people said it couldn’t be done. But you believed — not just in me, but that our Republic is worth defending, and Georgia could lead the way. Then we won. Not just a Senate seat, but the Senate majority for Democrats. Now, Trump has launched a power grab unprecedented in our history, abusing his power and trying to poison our Republic with fear and intimidation. Americans are now living in fear of their own government. I’m fighting back, but I can’t do this alone. I need you with me. = = As always, Jon Ossoff | Paid for by Martin Heinrich for Senate Senator Martin Heinrich is committed to helping New Mexico become a leader in defense, tech, and energy with opportunities in every corner. clean_body: Step by step, race by race, the work we do together is building the movement that will defeat Donald Trump and his allies. | = = Peter — I know how exhausting this moment feels. Every day, Republicans are tearing at the fabric of our democracy and stripping away our freedom. Some days, the road to taking back power seems impossibly long. But here's what I want you to remember: Step by step, race by race, the work we do together is building the movement that will defeat Donald Trump and his allies. I wake up each morning with the unshakable belief that the women we elect today will not only be at the center of winning back power, but ultimately they will be the leaders of the movement that saves our democracy. When I step into the EMILYs List office, I'm surrounded by people — veterans of this fight and brand-new interns alike — who carry that same fire in their hearts. This is what fuels me, even on the toughest days. = | = The women we support bring leadership that is rooted in their lived personal and professional experience and their deep ties to their communities — they're small business owners who know what it takes to keep local economies strong, journalists who've held the powerful accountable, teachers who've seen students go without the resources they need, and mothers working to make sure their kids have a fair shot at a secure future. They're running because they refuse to let extremists write the next chapter of American history. And because of their backgrounds and experiences, they are uniquely equipped to connect with voters, win tough races, and deliver the bold leadership this moment demands. Right now, these Democratic pro-choice women are at the center of critical races that will determine whether we reclaim the U.S. House majority in 2026 — and with it, our ability to lower costs, expand access to quality health care, and build an economy that actually works for American families. Meanwhile, Republicans are using every tool at their disposal, from stacked courts to gerrymandered maps to voter suppression tactics and shady billionaire money, to roll back decades of progress. It's enough to make you want to scream. With hard hat on, our founder Derek Marshall was at the groundbreaking of a collaborative housing project - proof that when neighbors grab the same shovel, we can move mountains. From foundation to roofline, this is a success story built by and for the people. It shows how collective action can pour real concrete under big ideas, tackling affordability, strengthening local power, and making sure everyone has a place to call home. As the only Democrat who can flip a Governor's seat blue this year, I want to set an example for the nation.

That's why we've knocked on over 250,000 doors so far. It's why we've launched plans to make life more affordable and strengthen our schools. And it's why we've committed to building the largest grassroots campaign in our Commonwealth's history.

_This won't be an easy race, but I'm used to overcoming the odds._

Back in 2018, I ran for Congress in a district that Republicans had controlled for 50 years. People told me that I shouldn't run, that I couldn't win.

_Well, together, we pulled off the impossible._

**Now, I'm running for Governor of Virginia in the biggest election yet of Trump's second term.** National Republicans are throwing millions of dollars at us, and Trump himself has started launching attacks, but I know this team will have my back with so much on the line.

At the end of this month, we will be filing the first of our quarterly fundraising reports with the FEC.

You know what this means by now: Our opponent and his national Republican allies will soon see how much we’ve raised — they’ll see any drop in our fundraising numbers as evidence of weakness, and they’ll determine what they need to spend against us this fall and beyond based on that number.

The GOP machine can try to buy this seat, but I know that we can defeat them by standing together. **After all, we’ve won some of the toughest races in North Carolina before.**

subject: Our most important deadline is tomorrow night.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY GARY MILLER FOR DELEGATE** 121 Bell Ct
body:
I’ve spent my life responding to emergencies. As a cardiologist, I learned that you have to act with purpose and urgency when a life is on the line.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/2dcec9098399/our-most-important-deadline-is-tomorrow-night?e=606d7e9aa2)
---
| | | | |
---
[|
---](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=a734caaa53&e=606d7e9aa2)
| |

Friend,
I’ve spent my life responding to emergencies. As a cardiologist, I learned that you have to **act with purpose and urgency** when a life is on the line.
I believe the future of our Commonwealth is on the line. Tomorrow night at midnight, we face what is truly the **most important fundraising deadline of this entire race** : a moment that will determine if we have the resources not just to fight back, but to win.
You may not live in Southside Virginia, but the dangerous agenda coming out of Washington doesn’t stop at the county lines. The **attacks on our public schools** , the reckless **cuts to Medicaid** that threaten to close our rural hospitals, and the efforts to **slash SNAP** benefits for working families and seniors. These are threats to all of us.The Virginia House of Delegates is our firewall. It’s our last line of defense, and **every single seat we flip is another vote to protect our schools, our healthcare, and our communities.**
That’s why this race in the 49th District matters so much. For the first time in 25 years, this is an open seat with a real, mathematical path to victory against a**MAGA-aligned opponent** who would rubber-stamp these devastating cuts.
I’m not a career politician. I’m a doctor and a City Councilman who has spent decades solving problems and getting results for this community. My opponent has chosen a different path, aligning himself with an agenda that would hurt the very people we are all sworn to serve.
That’s why this deadline tomorrow night is about more than just the [funds we raise](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=01506e1ce5&e=606d7e9aa2). It's about the report we file. Major organizations and partners across Virginia will be **looking at our numbers** to decide where to invest their resources for the fall.
A strong report proves this race is winnable and that our grassroots movement has the power to flip this seat. Your contribution right now sends a powerful message that we are **ready to win** and will help us secure the major support we need for the final stretch.**
**[**[Chip in $25 now]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=afd568f49c&e=606d7e9aa2)[**[Chip in $50 now]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=9e42465ac3&e=606d7e9aa2)[**[Chip in $100 now]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=f2803b56ae&e=606d7e9aa2)[**[Or chip in any amount]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=dc5749420b&e=606d7e9aa2)
This race is about more than one district. It's about what kind of Commonwealth we want to be.
Thank you for standing with me in this fight.
With gratitude,
Dr. Gary MillerCandidate for House of Delegates District 49

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Nothing says you’re in touch with working-class voters like holding a
crypto-backed Napa Valley wine retreat for millionaire and billionaire
donors in the middle of a potential government shutdown...

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250929?refcode=em20250929-37066&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=37066_1203867_LFLDTL&akid=37066%2E1203867%2ELFLDTL ]A screenshot from a Politico article reading: 'Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand
(D-N.Y.) has circulated an invitation obtained by Playbook for a 'Napa
Retreat' for the DSCC on Oct. 13 and 14. Should the government shut down
next week, the retreat could fall on what might be day 12 of a shutdown.
The itinerary features accommodations at the Hotel Yountville, with a
resort and spa that 'extends a Tuscan-European vibe,' and a wine tour and
dinner at the Staglin Family Vineyards amid its wine caves. The plans for
the luxury trip come amid Trump administration threats of mass firings of
federal workers. A Democrat briefed on the event tells us it also is
slated to include Rep. Haley Stevens (D-Mich.), who is campaigning for her
state’s open Senate seat as a gritty daughter of the Midwest. A Stevens
invite establishes the closest link so far between Stevens and the DSCC’s
preference for her in Michigan’s three-way primary among Stevens, state
Sen. Mallory McMorrow and former public health official Abdul El-Sayed.
The event is also said to feature a crypto roundtable on its sidelines,
this person said.'

That’s exactly what DSCC chair and crypto cheerleader Sen. Kirsten
Gillibrand is doing next week. She’s inviting megadonors to a lavish
fundraiser at a resort and spa, complete with dinner in a wine cave and a
crypto roundtable, all for the people supposedly in charge of winning
working-class voters back to regain Democratic majorities in Congress.

And it could be happening on Day 12 of a government shutdown, when federal
workers may be out of work and services are paused for the people who need
them.

We can’t say we’re surprised: this is exactly what we should have expected
when the biggest corporate shills in the Democratic Party are still in the
driver's seat.

They are the failures—not the future—of this Party.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250929?refcode=em20250929-37066&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=37066_1203867_LFLDTL&akid=37066%2E1203867%2ELFLDTL ]Help us recruit, support, and elect more working-class, progressive
candidates to challenge the out-of-touch, corporate establishment in 2026:
rush a grassroots contribution of $5 or more before
tomorrow’s end-of-quarter deadline.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250929?refcode=em20250929-37066&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=37066_1203867_LFLDTL&akid=37066%2E1203867%2ELFLDTL ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116208638/572817569/-492875955?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2025.09.29_Scarf-EOQ_B2_F1_S1_C1_U1_N-T1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZTYzZDgwMS04ZjlkLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tmG5ucg7mZAuNZJuaEWfSlu1uuBKiacGWhiExXd-Rds=) It's truly a full-circle story: I had that scarf 157 years later, as I was sworn in as the first woman and person of color to represent Delaware in the Senate.

_It's surreal knowing how far my family and other people of color have come. From being enslaved, to finally getting the right to vote, to having people who look like us in Congress._

Fox News and the right wing would have you believe that my American values are something out of the communist manifesto.
But I don’t believe in healthcare, labor, and human dignity because I’m an extremist.
**I believe these things because I was a waitress**.
Because I’ve worked double shifts to keep the lights on.
Because I did lose a parent to cancer and I saw my mom open the hospital bill a couple of days later.
Because on my worst day, **I know what it feels like to feel left behind**.
I don’t want any of us to live like this anymore. We deserve better.

subject: They want to buy this district
body:
| | Peter – I’m a fifth-generation Washingtonian and a small business owner. I ran for Congress because I was tired of politicians rubber-stamping the agenda of party bosses while communities like ours were left behind.

This seat belongs to us, and I intend to keep it that way. But now, national Republicans and outside special interests have handpicked their candidate, and they’re already pouring money into attack ads designed to tear us down.
